confirm_remove_profile.title: Remove this profile?
confirm_remove_profile.description: Removing a profile also discards only that recipient's saved delivery state.

confirm_automatic.title: Enable automatic official hazards?
confirm_automatic.description: This profile will receive relevant official warnings, watches, and health or behavior notices in its selected hazard families. Source degradation means unknown risk, not no risk.

confirm_critical.title: Allow critical delivery?
confirm_critical.description: Critical alerts may bypass silent or Do Not Disturb settings and make sound. Platform permissions and notification-channel settings still apply.

confirm_initial_automatic.title: Enable automatic official hazards?
confirm_initial_automatic.description: Confirm real delivery for this profile's selected official hazard families. Briefing-only outlooks remain in the daily picture.

confirm_initial_critical.title: Allow critical delivery?
confirm_initial_critical.description: Confirm separately that qualifying active warnings may use the Companion apps' documented critical/high-priority fields.

error.invalid_profile: Check the profile fields. A Person and profile name may be used only once, and critical delivery requires automatic delivery plus the phone-specific Companion action.
